# Best Family-Friendly Resorts in Phuket with Kids Clubs (2026)

Phuket is one of Asia's best family beach destinations. We've tested the top resorts with our own kids to find which ones truly deliver for families.

## What Makes a Great Kids Club?

- Supervised hours (at least 6 hours/day, including evenings)
- Age-appropriate programs for toddlers, kids, and tweens
- Qualified childcare professionals
- Indoor-outdoor balance (AC playrooms + outdoor playgrounds)
- Meals included in some programs

## 1. Club Med Phuket

Rating: 5/5

Club Med Phuket is the gold standard for family resorts in Asia.

Kids Club Programs:
- Petit Club (2-3 years): Supervised play, arts, music, naps
- Mini Club (4-10 years): Trapeze, sailing, arts and crafts, sports
- Passworld (11-17 years): Teens-only activities, social events

Why it works: Trained G.O.s (Gentle Organizers) keep kids engaged while parents enjoy adult-only spaces. The kids' club runs from 9 AM to 9 PM.

Pool: Freeform pool with kids' section and water features.

Best for: Families who want genuine time off while kids have a vacation of their own.

Price: ~$250-400/night all-inclusive

[Book on Klook](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/622-club-med-phuket/)
[Check rates on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Phuket&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-07&group_adults=2&group_children=1)

## 2. Anantara Vacation Club Mai Khao

Rating: 4.5/5

Kids Club Programs:
- Anantara Kidz Club (4-12 years): Thai boxing, fruit carving, Batik painting
- Supervised from 9 AM to 6 PM
- Evening babysitting available

Unique Feature: The resort has the longest lagoon pool in Phuket (300m). Kids can swim from their room to the restaurant.

Best for: Extended stays with apartment-style accommodation (full kitchen, separate bedrooms).

Price: ~$200-350/night for 2-bedroom

[Check rates on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Phuket&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-10&group_adults=2&group_children=2)

## 3. Holiday Inn Resort Phuket (Patong)

Rating: 4.5/5

Kids Club Programs:
- Planet Trekkers (4-12 years): Video games, arts, outdoor activities
- Supervised from 8 AM to 6 PM

Unique Feature: Massive lagoon-style pool complex with waterslides. The kids' pool area has splash pads and fountains.

Best for: Families who want Patong Beach access with a resort bubble.

Price: ~$100-200/night

[Check rates on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Phuket&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-07&group_adults=2&group_children=2)

## 4. Sunwing Resort Kamala

Rating: 4.5/5

This resort is designed specifically for families with young children. The entire property is kid-focused.

Kids Club Programs:
- Sunwing Kids Club (1-12 years): Multiple age groups
- Water play area and dedicated kids' pool
- Daily activity schedule with shows, treasure hunts, and pool games

Unique Feature: Kids' water park with small slides, splash pads, and a pirate ship play structure.

Best for: Families with toddlers and preschoolers.

Price: ~$120-250/night

[Check rates on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Phuket&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-07&group_adults=2&group_children=2)

## 5. JW Marriott Phuket Resort & Spa

Rating: 4/5

Kids Club Programs:
- Kids Club (4-12 years): Thai cooking, Batik painting, beach games
- Supervised from 9 AM to 5 PM

Unique Feature: Turtle release program at nearby Mai Khao beach. The resort grounds are massive with multiple pools.

Best for: Families who want a large resort with plenty of space and options.

Price: ~$150-350/night

[Check rates on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Phuket&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-07&group_adults=2&group_children=2)

## 6. Centara Grand Beach Resort Phuket (Karon)

Rating: 4/5

Kids Club Programs:
- Kids Club (4-12 years): Daily activities, games, crafts
- Teens Club (13-17 years): Gaming, sports, movie nights

Unique Feature: Multiple pool areas including a dedicated kids' pool with water features. Direct beach access to Karon Beach.

Best for: Families who want a variety of dining and activity options.

Price: ~$130-280/night

[Check rates on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Phuket&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-07&group_adults=2&group_children=2)

## 7. Kata Beach Resorts (multiple)

Kata Beach has several family-friendly resorts including:
- **Kata Thani** - Large pool, kids' club, direct beach access
- **Kata Palm Resort** - Multiple pools, family rooms, budget-friendly
- **Club Med Kata** - All-inclusive with excellent kids' club

Best for: Families who want easy beach and restaurant access in a family-focused area.

## Tips for Choosing a Phuket Family Resort

- Check kids club age limits - some don't accept under 4
- Look for "Kids Stay Free" programs (Holiday Inn, Sunwing)
- Consider location - Mai Khao is quiet, Patong is busy, Kata is balanced
- Read recent reviews - kids club quality can change with management
- Book directly for best family packages with meals included

## The Verdict

Club Med Phuket is our top pick for families who want genuine time off. Sunwing Kamala is perfect for families with toddlers. Holiday Inn Patong offers the best value with waterslides.
